branches_qr_lookup.name: branches_qr_lookup
branches_qr_lookup.using:
exists (
        select 1
        from dining_tables dt
        where dt.branch_id = "branches"."id"
          and dt.qr_token = nullif(current_setting('app.qr_token', true), '')
      )

restaurants_member_read.name: restaurants_member_read
restaurants_member_read.using:
exists (
        select 1
        from memberships m
        where m.restaurant_id = "restaurants"."id"
          and m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid
          and m.status = 'active'
      )
